items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He would always come to my gig. He knew he could sit in, play with me.

ctx.x: What – did you have a relationship with him? I know you recorded with him, but the . . .

Yeah, we had a relationship, because he – I used to let him sit in with me when he first was coming to New York and trying to make a name for himself. He would always come to my gig. He knew he could sit in, play with me.
